# Steve's Handyman LLC — Complete Operational Profile

## Organization & Authority
- Legal Entity: Steve's Handyman LLC
- Principal Owner: Steve Miller (Master Craftsman, 25+ Years Experience)
- Trade Licensing & Protection: Licensed General Contractor, $1,000,000 General Liability Insurance Policy
- Coverage Zone: Grayson County, TX including Denison, Sherman, Pottsboro, Lake Texoma, Whitesboro, Van Alstyne, and Howe.

## Service Catalog
1. Custom Carpentry & Trim Work: Crown molding, door casing, wainscoting, bespoke built-ins, mantles, cabinet doors.
2. Drywall Repair & Seamless Texture Matching: Drywall holes, ceiling leaks, stress cracks, drywall skim coating, orange peel, knockdown, smooth finishes.
3. Interior & Exterior Painting: Sherwin-Williams coatings, caulking, trim enameling, weatherproofing.
4. Plumbing Fixture Installation: Faucets, sink basins, toilet replacements, supply lines, garbage disposals, frost-free hose bibbs.
5. Lighting, Ceiling Fans & Electrical Fixtures: Fixture replacement, dimmers, timer switches, USB outlets, GFCI outlets, ceiling fans.
6. Deck Restoration & Rot Repair: Deck boards, cedar fencing, rotted fascia boards, soffits, pressure washing, exterior stain.
7. Doors & Windows: Pre-hung interior and exterior doors, storm doors, sliding door track adjustments, deadbolts.
8. Punch-List Services: TV mounting, fixture assembly, home inspection repairs, senior safety grab bars.

## Customer Guarantees
- 365-Day Labor Warranty: All craftsmanship is warranted against defect for one full calendar year.
- Clean-Site Guarantee: Protective floor runners, shoe covers, and HEPA vacuum cleanup on every visit.
- Upfront Pricing: Fixed quotes before work begins. No surprises or travel fees within Grayson County.
